critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated WCAG checks report no confirmed violations, but remain inconclusive for 6 serious prohibited-ARIA nodes, 2 critical duplicate-ID/ARIA nodes, and 484–553 serious color-contrast nodes. Keyboard navigation reaches #economics, no touch-target violations were measured, document width equals viewport at all sizes, the skip-link target is 158×46 px, and reduced-motion testing shows no animated transform or opacity change.
critique.fix: Resolve the prohibited ARIA attributes and duplicate IDs, then verify every flagged foreground/background pair meets WCAG contrast thresholds. Rerun the audit until these critical and serious checks produce conclusive passes at all three viewports; retain the proven keyboard, touch-target, no-overflow, skip-link, and reduced-motion behavior.
